storage: existing NativeSessionStorage AES-GCM/atomic record; no new namespace or key

import.preferences: retain choices, force enabled=false, assign new revision and increment generation; system POST_NOTIFICATIONS and channel permission are not migrated
import.leases: do not activate imported leases; require verified saved target and local credential-reference epoch
import.receipts: preserve original receipts/unknown states in immutable migration archive; never re-post or enable imported click tickets; active local receipts start empty
import.reading: P7 owns separate ledger; badge/sound/notification choices do not erase read state or tombstones
import.sounds: references only in this stage; no imported files/key/URI grant implemented; missing or unsupported sound blocks posting rather than claiming ready
import.push: no token, public/private encryption key, provider registration or revocation material exists in this stage; any future schema must version/inventory these explicitly
import.unknownRecords: reject unknown schema or oversized records without modifying original files; no silent reset or skip

implementation: contract only; no second migration implementation in P9
